title: Two-provider agent tests with provider authentication on
description: mimid-agent's two_providers() helper (tests/common, bead mimid-4jvf) wires a.example and b.example as mimid-server's two-provider tests do: plain HTTP, no provider_auth::check layer and no RequestSigner. Run irc_two_providers (or a subset) with RFC 9421 signatures and configured keys between the two, as main.rs layers them, to show the agent path works with provider auth enforced.
